claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Efest IMR 18650 2000mAh 10A as a 2000mAh preset with a 10A runtime rating.
HKJ's Efest IMR 18650 2000mAh review records a red V1 revision as flat-top at approximately 18.11 mm x 65.02 mm and a red V2 revision as button-top at approximately 18.10 mm x 66.06 mm.

The Efest IMR 18650 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry Efest IMR 18650 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2013-02-23 or earlier.

authenticity.summary: Two historical red Efest 18650 2000mAh revisions are documented, but the catalog entry does not identify the revision or underlying OEM cell.
checks: Identify whether the cell matches the V1 flat-top or V2 button-top red wrapper before applying dimensions or test conclusions.
Inspect label layout, wrapper, and terminal against a known-good sample.
Do not infer the underlying OEM cell from Efest branding alone.
